Depends on collecting items (several days); 30 min per addon to hand in

Quest for the {wiki:Mage Outfits|Mage Outfit} addons. Female characters get the Fluid Belt (vial lottery with {npc:Sandra}) and the Tiara (ingredients for {npc:Myra} in Port Hope). Male characters get the Wand (rescue {npc:Angelina} in the Dark Cathedral and deliver ingredients to {npc:Lynda}) and the Hat (deliver {item:Ferumbras' Hat} to {npc:Zoltan}). The quest also gives the achievement **Alumni** (male) or **Ritualist** (female).
Great for old and wise mages, as well as for beautiful sorceresses. If you want to earn addons, the ladies should take a stroll through Port Hope, while the elders should explore the Dark Cathedral.
No minimum level (recommended 60–200, especially for hunting the items).
Fluid Belt and Tiara: **female** characters only. Wand and Hat: **male** characters only.
Fluid Belt: at least 100 empty vials per ticket (on average ~10,000 are needed), or a Winning Lottery Ticket
15 for the Tiara, 10 for the Wand

Wand: the 5 wands ({item:Wand of Vortex}, {item:Wand of Dragonbreath}, {item:Wand of Decay}, {item:Wand of Cosmic Energy}, {item:Wand of Inferno}) and the 5 rods ({item:Snakebite Rod}, {item:Moonlight Rod}, {item:Necrotic Rod}, {item:Terra Rod}, {item:Hailstorm Rod})
Gather **all** the items before talking to the NPC: you hand everything in one go and save trips.
The Mage Outfit itself is available to everyone; only the addons are part of the quest.

The addons of the Mage and the {wiki:Summoner Outfits|Summoner} are swapped between the sexes: the male Mage's Wand and Hat correspond to the female Summoner's addons, and the female Mage's Fluid Belt and Tiara correspond to the male Summoner's. If you change sex, you get the corresponding addon on the other outfit (e.g. a female Full Mage becomes a male Full Summoner). That is why you **cannot** get the Hat by doing the female Mage/male Summoner and changing sex.
You need empty vials. Every 100 vials handed in without taking the money gives you a lottery ticket; some tickets win the addon.
Go to {npc:Sandra}'s shop in **Edron** with at least 100 empty {item:Vial|vials}. Say {key:hi}, {key:vial} and {key:yes} to hear the offer, and {key:yes} again to sign up for the bonus system.
Female Mage with the Fluid Belt (addon 1)

With 100 or more empty vials, say {key:vial} and {key:yes} to receive a lottery ticket instead of the money. Each ticket costs 100 vials and wins or loses at random (it usually loses). Repeat until you get a {item:Winning Lottery Ticket}.
On average about 10,000 vials are needed. You can also buy a Winning Lottery Ticket from another player.
With the {item:Winning Lottery Ticket} in your inventory, say {key:prize} and {key:yes}.
To leave the bonus system (and get money for vials again), say {key:bonus} and {key:yes}.
Gather all the items before talking to {npc:Myra}, in Port Hope.
Trade {item:Red Robe|Red Robes} with {npc:Irmana} in Venore, or hunt {creature:Hero|Heroes}, Barbarians and {creature:Infernalist|Infernalists}
Give {item:Spider Silk} and 50 {item:Honeycomb|Honeycombs} to the mermaid {npc:Marina} in Meriana
{creature:Infernalist|Infernalists}, or by giving {item:Fire Sword|Fire Swords} to the magic shop Djinns in the Djinn towers
Go to **Port Hope** and talk to {npc:Myra}: {key:hi}, {key:outfit}, {key:tiara}, {key:yes}. She explains the whole list; confirm with {key:yes}.
Handing in the items in order
Hand in the items **in this order**, saying the keyword and confirming with {key:yes} each time:
After the last delivery say {key:addon} and {key:tiara}. Myra tells you to talk to {npc:Zoltan} at the Edron academy.
Go to **Edron**, to the {wiki:Noodles Academy of Modern Magic|Noodles Academy of Modern Magic}, and say {key:hi} and {key:Myra} to {npc:Zoltan}. He honours Myra's word and gives you the Tiara.

Go to **Venore** and leave the city to the **southwest**: the {wiki:Dark Cathedral} is south of the Venore swamp and the Outlaw Camp, **west** of the {wiki:Plains of Havoc}, and you can only get there by crossing the plains. The first two floors are reached by stairs; the deepest floor, where Angelina is, can only be reached through the teleport. From the stairs on the 2nd floor go **south** to a big room: the teleport is at the end of it and the 6 levers are in the 5 rooms around it.
On the plains there may be a {creature:Giant Spider} lured there by other players.
Rescue Angelina in the Dark Cathedral
Go to the {wiki:Dark Cathedral|Dark Cathedral}, go down **2 floors** and pull the **6 levers**. Then enter the teleport. To find {npc:Angelina}, go as far **north** as possible and then **east**.

In the Dark Cathedral there are {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}, {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}, {creature:Wild Warrior|Wild Warriors}, {creature:Smuggler|Smugglers}, {creature:Bandit|Bandits}, {creature:Assassin|Assassins}, {creature:Witch|Witches}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, {creature:Mummy|Mummies}, {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems}, {creature:Dark Monk|Dark Monks}, {creature:Monk (Creature)|Monks}, {creature:Slime|Slimes} and {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}.
There is a time limit after you pull the levers: enter the teleport right away. It is easier with friends (or clear the monsters first and pull the levers on a second run).
Say {key:hi} and {key:yes}. She sends you to her friend {npc:Lynda}, in Thais.

To leave, use the teleport that leads out of the deepest floor, next to {npc:Angelina}, and then go up the stairs you came down to the surface. Go back to Venore the same way and take the boat to **Thais** ({key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}), where Lynda is.
Angelina, next to the exit teleport
Go to **Thais** and talk to {npc:Lynda}: {key:hi}, {key:Angelina}, {key:yes}. She explains the ingredients; confirm again with {key:yes}.
Hand in the items in this order, always confirming with {key:yes}:

The 5 rods ({item:Snakebite Rod}, {item:Moonlight Rod}, {item:Necrotic Rod}, {item:Terra Rod}, {item:Hailstorm Rod}) and the 5 wands ({item:Wand of Vortex}, {item:Wand of Dragonbreath}, {item:Wand of Decay}, {item:Wand of Cosmic Energy}, {item:Wand of Inferno}), **all at once**
Wait 3 hours and get the Wand
Wait **3 hours** and go back to Lynda. Say {key:ritual}: if the time has not passed yet, she asks you to wait.
You need {item:Ferumbras' Hat}, the proof that {creature:Ferumbras} has been defeated.
Go to {npc:Zoltan} at the {wiki:Noodles Academy of Modern Magic|Noodles Academy of Modern Magic}, in **Edron**, and say {key:hi}, {key:proof} and {key:yes}.
This quest gives the achievement **Alumni** (male character) or **Ritualist** (female character).

The dangers listed for the items depend on what you go hunting: {creature:Ferumbras}, {creature:Necropharus}, Monks, Dark Monks and {creature:Fernfang}, **or** Bats, Heroes, Apes, Elf Arcanists, Giant Spiders, Wasps/Bears, Lizards, Dragon Lords and Vampires.
